claims.text: The evaluation includes gold standard event selection for comparing generated text to reference text.
Edit distance is used as a measure to reflect the effort needed to correct the generated output.
The word error rate (WER) of the generated text is reported as 5.6%.
BLEU scores are used to evaluate the fluency of the generated text, indicating a correlation with factual accuracy.
